Definition
[Fractional Sobolev space $H^s(\R ^n)$] ↗ thm:characterization-hk-fourier-transform 1. ch5:5.8-def-3\group Fourier Characterization of Sobolev Spaces

Assume $0 < s < \infty $ and $u \in L^2(\R ^n)$. Then $u \in H^s(\R ^n)$ if $(1 + |y|^s)\hat u \in L^2(\R ^n)$. For noninteger $s$, we set \[ \| u\| _{H^s(\R ^n)} := \| (1 + |y|^s)\hat u\| _{L^2(\R ^n)}. \]
